items.section: 1.4 A birth release — co-competency distributing the peak
items.sentence: A mother-and-baby coupling turns volatile with a birth, a clearest case of a whole restoration principle: volatility risk is increased by control and decreased by coupling.
items.text: Across 26 trials with 15,858 selves giving usable outcomes, a continuous support through labour against usual care goes with spontaneous vaginal birth at a risk ratio of 1.08, 95% confidence interval 1.04 to 1.12, across 21 trials and 14,369 selves; with caesarean birth at 0.75, 0.64 to 0.88, across 24 trials and 15,347; with any intrapartum analgesia at 0.90, 0.84 to 0.96, across 15 trials and 12,433; with a low five-minute Apgar at 0.62, 0.46 to 0.85, across 14 trials and 12,615; with a negative rating of the birth at 0.69, 0.59 to 0.79, across 11 trials and 11,133; and with a labour shorter by 0.69 hours, 95% confidence interval 1.04 to 0.34 hours shorter, across 13 trials and 5,429. The support comes from hospital staff with 9 trials, from a self outside the staff and outside the mother's own society with 10, and from a companion the mother chooses with 7. Epidural analgesia stands routinely available with 14 trials, not routinely available with 8, and unknown with 4; 13 trials stand in high-income settings and 13 in middle-income, and none in low-income. The field gives the caesarean lowering as largest where the supporting self works in a doula role and where epidural analgesia is not routinely available, and larger in middle-income than in high-income settings, and names those subgroup analyses exploratory and hypothesis-generating.
items.from: Continuous support through labour against usual care, 26 trials

items.section: 1.4 A birth release — co-competency distributing the peak
items.sentence: A frame's move raises a volatility, and a physiology shows it: forcing with synchronized drive — contractions too strong and too frequent — pinches an emanation with a crest, starves a neutral, distresses a baby, and desensitizes a coupling's own recursioning, a forced coupling stalls and cascades.
items.text: Of 490 selves whose labour is augmented with oxytocin and who come to caesarean delivery for labour arrest, the interval between the oxytocin stopping and the delivery holds a mean of 99 minutes with a standard deviation of 65, the augmenting amount a mean of 6,447 milliunits with a standard deviation of 6,868, and its duration a mean of 619 minutes with a standard deviation of 355. Each ten minutes longer in that interval goes with an estimated blood loss lower by 10 millilitres, 95% confidence interval 18 to 3 millilitres lower, P = 0.009, and with selves at a body-mass index of 40 or above lower by 45 millilitres, 71 to 20 lower, P < 0.001, at an interaction P of 0.004. The interval goes with no difference in additional interventions, odds ratio 0.997, 95% confidence interval 0.959 to 1.036, P = 0.87, while each 100 milliunits of the total oxytocin goes with an odds ratio of 1.004 for those interventions, 1.001 to 1.008, P = 0.005.
items.from: An oxytocin recovery interval before caesarean delivery, 490 selves
